declared: 2026-11-14, third step of the pIce-at-bound diagnosis (steps 1 and 2: lapsim-exp/trac-2026-11-14, lapsim-exp/fexp-2026-11-14). F1 only. Finding: the F1 objective uses corner minima, straight-end speeds, lap and sector times. It holds no acceleration shape, so engine power and drag trade against each other. Local screen: with power held near the direct estimate the fit score is the same as production (26.2124 against 26.2126) and drag rises from 1.09 to 1.42 m2, close to the direct estimate. Direct estimate (scripts/sim/estimate-power.mjs, layer 3): wheel power 613, 611 and 600 kW for 2023, 2024 and 2025 (leave-one-track-out spread 5-9 kW), which is 0.94, 0.93 and 0.91 of the rules estimate of ICE power. Candidate: LAPSIM_PICE_MEASURED=on takes pIce for 2023-2025 from that table and does not fit it (rule 3.1: never fit a value that can be measured). 2026 stays fitted: its electrical power varies along the lap and the estimate is not usable. Variants: A = production flags (baseline), M = A + PICE_MEASURED, KM = M + LAPSIM_FEXP (combined-grip exponent, step 2). Fit length and held-out method: identical to the f1-converged run of the same day. Metrics: held-out RMS per season (gate.mjs), corner minimum bias, trap error, bound hits (exp-compare --physics). Pass for M: F1 2025 and 2026 held-out error not worse than A beyond noise (M removes a fitted value, so equal is a pass), corner bias and trap error not worse, no new value at a bound. Pass for KM: gate accepted against A, same physical checks; frictionExp at its bound is a finding and blocks acceptance. Local screens (3 rounds, 60 iterations, no folds, not converged): KM score 19.23, corner minimum bias 2025 -2.3 km/h, 2025 downforce 6.43 (off its bound), frictionExp 1.00 (at its bound). No variants added after results.
